headline: IHSG Session I Falls 1.5%, Foreigners Buy 10 Stocks
summary: The Jakarta Composite Index fell 1.50% in the morning session on November 20, 2026, on turnover of Rp3.7 trillion. Foreign investors were net sellers of Rp398.3 billion.
why: The Jakarta Composite Index is Indonesia's main stock benchmark, and foreign flows are a key driver of its liquidity and price moves.
why_moved: The index fell 1.50% in the morning session, and foreign investors were net sellers of Rp398.3 billion.
original_headline: IHSG Sesi I Turun 1,5% di Sesi I, Asing Malah Borong 10 Saham Ini
